verdicts.reason: A gets the hierarchy wrong. The legal disclaimer is set as a large four-line block on the left, as prominent as the body copy. The SUNSET SALE ribbon has shrunk to an unreadable sliver next to the can. The three badges are now microscopic labels around the CTA, and a stray orange dash floats beside the headline. B keeps the SUNSET SALE badge readable and stacks the three badges as a legible column next to the CTA, with the legal text correctly shrunk to fine print. B still has problems: the can is tiny, the badge crowds the logo and product, a stray red fragment sits under the CTA, and the headline is cramped against the badge column.
